visualCharacteristics.purpose: interactive financial calculator (loan payment, GIC return, rewards, rebate, RRSP) with an optional intro panel, labelled inputs, a submit/CTA button and an optional illustration

contentPattern.structure: Rows in any order. Intro rows: heading, text and links in one or more cells. Field rows: two or three cells - label (plain text, leading or trailing * marks required) | field spec (an input type word such as number, text, range, optionally with a prefix and suffix, e.g. '$ number' or 'number %' or 'number Year'; or a list of choices for a dropdown, with 'checkbox' or 'radio' to render choice tiles) | optional help text. Button row: one cell containing a single link - '#' (or #calculate) becomes the submit button, any other URL stays a CTA link. Picture-only rows become the illustration. Content after the fields becomes notes. When amount, rate and period/term fields exist, submit shows the amortized monthly payment and total interest; every submit dispatches a calculator:submit event

reuseGuidance: Use for any calculator or calculator entry panel. Add options for layout: banner (intro beside form), intro (centered entry panel with Get Started CTA), image (illustration column). Colour/shadow options (alt, grey, blue, blue-grey, shadow, light) are styling hooks for the design pass. Complex calculators with charts or multi-step logic should be embedded via an iframe/embed block or a custom integration rather than authored fields.
